Technical glossary 10 terms

The brain predicts what is happening and updates the model when new information arrives.

You hear a sound and guess what caused it.

A mismatch between what the brain expected and what the senses report.

You think your phone rang, but it was someone else's phone.

A strong expectation or belief the brain already uses.

"People will judge me" can become a prior in social situations.

Information coming from the senses or body.

Light from a cup reaches your eyes.

The brain's expectation shaping what you notice.

You expect your keys on the table, so you look there first.

A brain network often linked with self-reference, memory, and mind-wandering.

Thinking about your past or future self.

The amount of uncertainty or possible patterns in a system.

A very ordered routine has lower entropy than a chaotic dream.

A temporary weakening of the usual feeling of being a separate self.

Some people report feeling less divided from the world.

A possible state where strong expectations become less controlling.

An old emotional story feels less fixed for a time.

Turning an insight into daily action.

Pausing in an argument because you remember your first story may be incomplete.

Key Concepts

The brain predicts what is happening and updates the model when new information arrives.

You hear a sound and guess what caused it.

A mismatch between what the brain expected and what the senses report.

You think your phone rang, but it was someone else's phone.

A strong expectation or belief the brain already uses.

"People will judge me" can become a prior in social situations.

Information coming from the senses or body.

Light from a cup reaches your eyes.

The brain's expectation shaping what you notice.

You expect your keys on the table, so you look there first.

A brain network often linked with self-reference, memory, and mind-wandering.

Thinking about your past or future self.

The amount of uncertainty or possible patterns in a system.

A very ordered routine has lower entropy than a chaotic dream.

A temporary weakening of the usual feeling of being a separate self.

Some people report feeling less divided from the world.

A possible state where strong expectations become less controlling.

An old emotional story feels less fixed for a time.

Turning an insight into daily action.
